articles.title: Global beverage majors advance India IPO plans, from DRHP filing to board approval
articles.content: Carlsberg has filed an updated draft red herring prospectus for its potential IPO in India. Pernod Ricard continues to prepare for its proposed listing while awaiting board approval for its Indian business. Coca-Cola is exploring a potential IPO for its Indian bottling operations, emphasizing the value in the domestic market. These developments indicate a growing interest in public listings among multinational beverage companies in India.

articles.title: IOC, BPCL, HPCL clock Rs 30,106 cr Q2 profit, nearly 39 pc of last year's annual earnings
articles.content: In the third quarter, spanning July to September, India's three major state-run fuel retailers announced a combined net profit of Rs 30,106 crore, reversing a previous loss of Rs 18,150 crore. This profitability surge defied the ongoing freeze on petrol and diesel prices since May. Indian Oil Corporation achieved its highest standalone quarterly net profit, buoyed by strong refining margins, yet faces ongoing challenges related to fuel under-recoveries.

articles.title: FPIs pull out Rs 34,843 cr from equities in Oct; turn net buyers last week
articles.content: Amidst rising economic fears, foreign portfolio investors withdrew Rs 34,843 crore from Indian equities in October. Although they had made significant contributions in July and August, outflows continued through September. By late October, a turnaround occurred as foreign investors became net buyers, infusing approximately Rs 6,300 crore into the market. Support from domestic institutional investors provided much-needed stability as all eyes turn to potential global impacts on investor sentiment.

articles.title: Sebi bars EKI Energy, MD Dabkara, others from market; imposes penalty
articles.content: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has taken serious action against EKI Energy Services Ltd and its Managing Director due to financial misreporting. The regulatory body discovered that the company recognized revenue too early and inflated expenses, distorting profit reports. In addition to the company's penalties totaling Rs 88 lakh, several executives were also fined for their complicity in these discrepancies.

articles.title: US bonds rally, sending yields to biggest monthly decline since 2023
articles.content: US Treasuries experienced a notable rise as technology stock selloffs caused a shift towards safer investments. The yield on the benchmark 10-year note had its largest monthly drop in nearly three years. Earnings reports from Amazon and Intel negatively impacted investor confidence amid rising AI costs. Expectations for a December interest rate hike remain high after a recent Federal Reserve meeting.
